description.narrative: An assessment of capacity for integrated LUP in both provinces is being conducted, serving as inputs for further discussion on how to adjust activities 1.1c, 1.1d, 1.1g and other activities relating to LUP. A training on Land use planner tool was organized with participation of 32 participants from Lam Dong and Dak Nong Provinces.
